names.name: Neon and the lit sign
names.said: The sign is on before anything else in the building is.

text.what: Signs that advertise by light: a neon ring, a lit arrow, a plastic panel with DONUTS in red, and the hot sign that says the fryer is going.
text.story:
Krispy Kreme's hot sign has an origin in the schedule rather than in advertising — Vernon Rudolph sold hot donuts to people who turned up during the midnight-to-four production run. Tunnel-oven shops from the early 2010s keep it lit all day.

Spudnut signs are a different kind of survivor: the franchise that sold them reached more than 300 shops in 38 states by 1954 and then vanished, leaving the signs on independent shops.
text.today: A shop's sign is usually older than its owners, and reads as the shop's real name whatever the paperwork says.
